proposal.utterance: Classify 'an act of promising' in BFO terms.

entities.label: ActOfPromising
entities.rationale: An act of promising is a temporally extended happening — a speech act performed by an agent that unfolds in time. It is not a continuant (it does not persist through time maintaining identity); rather, it occurs and then is over. BFO_0000015 (Process) is the correct top-level type. It is a common noun denoting a kind, so it is a class rather than an individual.

relations.rationale: ActOfPromising is a subclass of Process (BFO_0000015), as it is a kind of temporally unfolding occurrence involving at least one agent participant.

open_questions: Should ActOfPromising be further refined as a subclass of an existing working class such as ActOfAcknowledgment, or does it stand independently as a new process class?

Do you want to model the promise content (the propositional content of the promise, e.g. 'I will do X') as a Generically Dependent Continuant (BFO_0000031) — an information artifact — distinct from the act itself?
Do you want to capture the role of the promiser (the agent bearing a promissory obligation) as a Role (BFO_0000023) inhering in the agent who performs the act?

Is 'an act of promising' here intended as a token (a specific individual promise event) or a type (the general kind)? The utterance uses the indefinite article 'an', suggesting a type/class, but please confirm.
proposal.rationale_summary: An act of promising is ontologically a Process (BFO_0000015): it is an occurrent that unfolds in time, has a beginning and an end, and involves at least one agent as participant. It is not a continuant because it does not persist through time in the way a person or a document does. The propositional content of the promise (what is promised) could additionally be modeled as a Generically Dependent Continuant (BFO_0000031) — an information-bearing entity that can be tokened in multiple carriers — but that is a distinct entity from the act itself. Any promissory obligation that arises from the act would be a Specifically Dependent Continuant (a Role or Disposition, BFO_0000023 or BFO_0000016) inhering in the promiser. The utterance uses the indefinite article and a common noun, so ActOfPromising is introduced as a class, subclass of BFO_0000015.
